title: service sink
description: Sends a message to a named InOnly dil.core service contract: service:<name> or service:<namespace>:<name>.

delivery.description: processed waits for the provider; enqueue returns after buffering

requestTimeout.title: Request timeout
requestTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for the service provider

requestTimout.title: Request timeout (misspelled)
requestTimout.description: Same as requestTimeout, as the designer writes it; it wins when both are set

overflow.description: Admission policy when the service channel is full

enqueueTimeout.description: Admission timeout in milliseconds; positive value required with overflow block
